source.source_locator: 教則 第6章 6.2「安全のための気象状況の確認及び飛行の実施の判断」(1)

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 雷鳴は降雨開始前でも延期・中止を検討すべき気象条件である。
evidence.tested_misconception: 雨が降るまでは雷鳴だけで飛行を止める必要はない。
evidence.reasoning_path: thunder cue -> hazardous weather inference -> go/no-go -> postpone/cancel

collision.note: MEDIUM-LOW。既存の一般的なflight-start judgmentと近接するが、降雨前の雷鳴という具体的decision boundaryを問う。

independent_review.rationale: 6.2 says thunder is a postpone/cancel condition. Q096 tests fog; this adds the distinct pre-rain thunder decision boundary and misconception.

director_adjudication.rationale: Independent reviewer evidence is source-consistent and correctly distinguishes integration/decision-boundary variants from exact semantic collisions. The 23 accepted candidates retain distinct propositions and commercial practice value; the two collision candidates must not receive acceptance packets or Permanent IDs.
